claim: deploy.yml (Deploy to Production) acts only on this repository's own CI runs on main -- a push, or a manual (workflow_dispatch) run -- as far as a strict text reader can hold it. ci-gate carries no job-level if (plain, quoted or spaced key) and one refusal step equal, line for line, to the allowed text: it reads the triggering run's event and head repository through env and exits 1 unless the event is 'push' or 'workflow_dispatch' and the repository is this one (a dispatch from a fork is refused); ci-gate writes neither GITHUB_ENV nor GITHUB_OUTPUT. The on: block, up to the next top-level key, equals the allowed one and no defaults: is set. The jobs: block holds only plain job keys (a quoted, flow-style, anchored or aliased job key, a job-level line that is not a plain lowercase key (quoted, tagged, anchored, explicit or merge key), a five-space indent, an unclosed quoted job-level value, a tab or a duplicate fails), the job set is fixed, and each job's single job-level if (block scalars read with their blank lines, plain scalars with their continuation lines) equals the one allowed: every workflow_run-startable job requires the own-run group (event push or workflow_dispatch, and this repository), rollback-guide is dispatch-only; no job is a reusable-workflow call; nothing sets continue-on-error. Held by scripts/check_deploy_own_pushes.py (gate-owned, run with python3 -I), whose --self-test plants 52 breaks, every evasion the round-2 ADR 0090 audit found among them, plus a fork's dispatch, another event type and a missing repository check, each in a stage if and in the refusal step; run by scripts/test_pr_audit_gate.py. Not held: ci-gate's first step (the conclusion check, pinned separately by ADR-0097's row) and GitHub's own YAML evaluation (a form this reader accepts but GitHub reads differently) (workflow_run runs main's copy, so the step first runs on the merge commit's Deploy run). Founder, 2026-09-30, on #534, verbatim picks: "Sign off, add deploy fix (Recommended)", "Yes, covered (Recommended)" (his sign-off covers the guard and this fragment, 33 gate-owned files) and "Also allow manual runs" (so pr_audit_gate.py's CI-side merge re-entry, a workflow_dispatch of CI on main, still reaches the deploy audit).
